purpose: Pinned build and test toolchain for foss-mcp on Windows. The binaries live in tools/ (git-ignored, about 8 GB). This file records what they are, where each came from, and how to restore it. Nothing here is a credential.

tools.name: python
tools.source: https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-3132/ (Windows embeddable or full installer, no admin needed for the zip layout)
tools.used_by: project venv (.venv), all ops/gatectl.py and pytest runs

tools.name: git
tools.used_by: every git call, and bash.exe for .githooks and scripts/ci_check.sh

tools.name: rustup-user
tools.source: https://win.rustup.rs/x86_64 (rustup-init, profile minimal, default toolchain stable)

tools.name: rp-toolchains
tools.version: see tools/rp-toolchains/TOOLCHAIN_PATHS.txt (ninja 1.13.2, winlibs GCC 16.2.0, LLVM 19.1.7, rustup cargo 1.98.1, typescript 5.9.3)
tools.source: Assembled by earlier sessions; each component's own source is recorded in TOOLCHAIN_PATHS.txt inside the folder.
tools.used_by: example verifier: ninja, cargo (cargo-home and rustup-home), tsc, and the GCC/Clang probes

tools.name: dotnet-sdk
tools.used_by: example verifier (dotnet platform). Already installed on C:; not copied into tools/.

tools.name: docker-desktop
tools.used_by: compose stack, live-content e2e tests, container build tests. Not portable; reinstall with the installer.

tools.name: visual-studio-2022-community
tools.used_by: MSVC link.exe and cl.exe for the Rust build and the cells/cpp verifier. The C++ workload is NOT installed on this machine (no VC\Tools\MSVC). Owner action: add the 'Desktop development with C++' workload.

not_restored_by_design: Build caches and downloaded packages (npm cache, cargo registry, pip cache)
Docker images and volumes (rebuilt by docker compose)
Any other project's tools, such as the actions-runner tree on D:
